001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.display;
002
003import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
004
005import java.util.Collections;
006import java.util.HashMap;
007import java.util.Map;
008
009public enum DisplayType {
010  /*
011   * REALITEM = USE REAL DROPPED ITEM
012   * ARMORSTAND = USE ARMORSTAND DISPLAY
013   * VIRTUALITEM = USE VIRTUAL DROPPED ITEM (CLIENT SIDE)
014   * */
015  //REALITEM(0),
016  //  ARMORSTAND(1),
017  VIRTUALITEM(2),
018  DISPLAY_ENTITY(3),
019  CUSTOM(900);
020
021  private static final Map<Integer, DisplayType> TYPE_MAP;
022
023  static {
024    final Map<Integer, DisplayType> map = new HashMap<>(values().length);
025    for(final DisplayType type : values()) {
026      map.put(type.id, type);
027    }
028    TYPE_MAP = Collections.unmodifiableMap(map);
029  }
030
031  private final int id;
032
033  DisplayType(final int id) {
034
035    this.id = id;
036  }
037
038  public static @NotNull DisplayType fromID(final int id) {
039
040    return TYPE_MAP.getOrDefault(id, CUSTOM);
041  }
042
043  public static int toID(@NotNull final DisplayType displayType) {
044
045    return displayType.id;
046  }
047
048  public int toID() {
049
050    return id;
051  }
052}
